title: Here's what's crashing gold and likely weighing on bitcoin too
content: Gold fell to its lowest level since September 2025 on Friday, and the same catalyst driving its decline is likely also weighing on bitcoin.

title: Anthropic shares may fall 5% at Friday’s open, crypto futures suggest
content: About $1.7 billion traded through a Hyperliquid contract on the AI company’s shares in 24 hours, and the biggest position heading into Friday’s Nasdaq open is a $30 million short.

title: This Bitcoin miner sold 267 BTC to clear $22 million debt. It still may not survive
content: PowerCompute had its lender sell 267 pledged bitcoin in September, wiping out most of its debt, and ended the month with about $650,000 in cash and a going-concern warning.

title: Big money bought a net $4 billion of bitcoin funds in Q3, ending 9 months of selling
content: Wall Street piled into Bitcoin funds in the third quarter, ending a three-quarter selling streak, according to Galaxy Research. But the buying has given way to renewed selling this quarter.

title: Ethereum’s next big upgrade is pushed into 2027 by apps it would break
content: Glamsterdam was originally targeted for December, but developers now say January is the earliest possible date as companies work to fix affected smart contracts.

title: Anthropic’s $81B IPO draws half the net retail buying of SpaceX’s
content: Retail investors traded $772 million in Anthropic shares on Thursday, the most Vanda Research has recorded for a market debut since 2012.

title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
content: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: Institutions pile back into US Bitcoin ETFs in Q3 after selling streak
content: Asset managers added the equivalent of 49,229 Bitcoin to their US Bitcoin ETF holdings in the third quarter, reversing three quarters of net selling.

title: Ledger CTO Charles Guillemet to leave after nine years at company
content: Guillemet helped establish Ledger’s Donjon security lab and says his departure has been planned for months.

title: Binance’s $6.5B freeze order, Hong Kong ‘suspicious’ of HYPE: Asia Express
content: Binance obtains court orders freezing assets stolen in October’s hack. Hong Kong warns citizens about Hyperliquid, and Thai police arrest four foreigners linked to a crypto scam.

title: Citi Says Customers Are Responsible When AI Banking Agents Go Rogue—Even After a Hack
content: Citibank’s updated terms put customers on the hook for outside AI agents, including leaked logins.

title: Nvidia, AMD, Micron Sink as Anthropic Closes 17% Above IPO Price
content: Anthropic shares opened 34% above their $83 IPO price before giving up much of the gain, while Nvidia, AMD and other AI stocks slid across Wall Street.

title: Meet SHRINCS: Bitcoin's Emerging Frontrunner for a Post-Quantum Signature
content: A new post-quantum signature proposal aims to secure Bitcoin’s future, but balancing user safety and efficiency comes with hurdles.

title: Hackers Leak Visa, Mastercard and JPMorgan Customer Data
content: A ransomware group breached third-party vendors, not the companies’ own systems. Visa said no card data was affected while Mastercard cited a limited cardholder subset.

title: Bitcoin Enters Death Cross as Anthropic IPO Fails to Lift Wall Street
content: Anthropic shares surged on their Nasdaq debut, but stocks slid and Bitcoin fell lower. Its daily chart shows deeply oversold momentum, a strong downtrend, and fragile support.

title: Inside Bukele’s Casa Presidencial Dinner: Bitcoiners Discuss Energy, Immigration, and El Salvador’s Future
content: Bitcoin Magazine Inside Bukele’s Casa Presidencial Dinner: Bitcoiners Discuss Energy, Immigration, and El Salvador’s Future On November 10, 2026, President Nayib Bukele hosted roughly 30 Bitcoiners at Casa Presidencial during Bitcoin Histórico. Guests included Ricardo Salinas Pliego, Parker Lewis, Mike Peterson, and miners; discussions covered power generation for compute and immigration. This post Inside Bukele’s Casa Presidencial Dinner: Bitcoiners Discuss Energy, Immigration, and El Salvador’s Future first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Juan Galt .

title: Strategy (MSTR) Shares Tumble for Sixth Straight Day to $86 as Bitcoin Slides
content: Bitcoin Magazine Strategy (MSTR) Shares Tumble for Sixth Straight Day to $86 as Bitcoin Slides Strategy shares fell 4.6% to $86.13 on Thursday, their sixth straight decline, as bitcoin dipped below $62,000. The company's 850,849 BTC are now worth about $11 billion less than it paid. This post Strategy (MSTR) Shares Tumble for Sixth Straight Day to $86 as Bitcoin Slides first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: SEC Charges Eight Colorado Firms in $37 Million Fake Crypto Platform Scam
content: Bitcoin Magazine SEC Charges Eight Colorado Firms in $37 Million Fake Crypto Platform Scam The SEC charged eight Colorado-based entities, likely run from overseas, with taking more than $37 million from U.S. investors through fake advisers, fake crypto trading platforms and fake SEC certificates. This post SEC Charges Eight Colorado Firms in $37 Million Fake Crypto Platform Scam first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Bitcoin Price Slumps Under $62,000, Crashing 25% in One Month
content: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Price Slumps Under $62,000, Crashing 25% in One Month The bitcoin price slumped under $62,000 on Thursday, down about 24% in one month, as Anthropic's Nasdaq debut set off a tech selloff that hit crypto stocks. This post Bitcoin Price Slumps Under $62,000, Crashing 25% in One Month first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
